title: skills/objectstack-i18n: the group table misses `fields.{field}.inlineTitle` and `reports.{report}.blocks.{block}.{label,description}` (follow-up owed by PR #26757)
body:
Filing gate: ① a shipped-surface gap with a named location, owed by in-flight work (PR #26757, cards #26112 + #26142). It is filed now so the PR's `Skills-docs:` line can name it. Filed by `domain:spec` seat 3 · `os-support-ai` · session `session_01WGufzgbJhFoXYsLSe5WSPP`. ⛔ Not a claim.

**Business reason.** An AI author who writes a translation bundle from `skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md` will not translate a joined report's block headings or a master-detail field's inline grid title. The skill's group table does not name either key, so zh-CN users keep seeing those headings in English, even though the platform now serves them translated. The same kind of gap was closed for the 18.2 groups by #26296.

**Reader who acts.** The skills lane (`skills/**`, Tier H, which needs a human merge). Do this after PR #26757 lands, so the keys exist on `main`.

## What to change (measured on PR #26757 head `bcbc8374`)

- `skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md`, the `fields.{field_name}` row: add `inlineTitle`, the title of a master-detail field's inline child grid. When it is not translated it keeps its authored text; there is no fallback to the child's plural label.
- The same file, the sentence saying `reports` holds `label` + `description`: add `reports.{report}.blocks.{block_name}.{label,description}`. Block keys go by the block's required `name`, as `pages.{page}.components.{id}` does.
- One example row for each, in the skill's example bundle if it has one.
- **Same gap on the hand-written author page (added by the seat from contract review 6445499937, ③7):** `content/docs/ui/translations.mdx:71` (`objects.NAME.fields.FIELD.label / help / placeholder`) misses `inlineTitle`, and `:85` (`reports.NAME.label / description`) misses `reports.NAME.blocks.BLOCK.label / description`. `content/docs/ui/` is not governed, so that half can land in its own small PR ahead of the skill edit.
- **Stale header line:** `packages/lint/src/validate-translation-references.ts:163` ("Leaf keys below the name are the schema's (`label` / `description`, strict)") now misses `blocks`.

## Dedupe

`search_issues` on this repo: "objectstack-i18n skill translation keys group table missing reports blocks inlineTitle". 20 hits. The closest are #26296 (closed, the 18.2 group sweep of the same skill), #21583 (closed, `_actions` row), and #26112 / #26142 (the open source cards). None covers these two keys. **New.**
